messages.subject: Rashid — our advice on strategy and settlement range [PRIVILEGED]
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Patricia, Helen and Andrew,

Please find attached our advice note on the Rashid matter. In short: proceeding to dismissal now carries real risk, particularly on age discrimination (uncapped) and the whistleblowing allegation. We recommend a protected conversation and a clean-break settlement. Our recommended ex-gratia range is set out in section 5.

Grateful for confirmation of the negotiating mandate so we can issue the without-prejudice letter. Note the recommendation to review the rebate concern separately.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Chief Executive
